page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the scan) with a running head at top, one text column with a few marginal reference notes; a fragment of the neighbouring left page at the far left edge is not transcribed. Below the text a diagram-like brace outline (Actio conferentis / Actio recipientis; Actio conferentis Externa/Interna) and a footer word "Externa".

main_text.p: ſlumine Ægipti vsq; ad flumen illud magnum Euphrates, (quantum possidebant gentes decem, qui ibi enumerantur. Kenai, Kenizzei, Kadmonæi, Chittæi, Perizzæi, Raphæi, Emoræi, Cenahannæi. Girgagehæi, Iebusæi, etsi ipso in pace cùm canitie bona sepulto, semen ipsius in Chananæa & Ægypto quadringentos annos seruituros & afflictos fore prædicebat: semini tamen reuerso daturum. Gen. 15. 13. 20.

Confirmatio erat, vt vitula & ariete trienni cum turture & pullo columbarum dissectis & collocata dimidiata cuiusq; parte è regione suæ alterius: Deus in Abrahamum, aues abigentem à cadaueribus illis, altum soporem, terrorem & tenebras maximas inijciens, per medium in symbolum confirmationis transiret. Gen. 15. 8. 9. 10. 11. 12. Ier. 34. 18. Vnde etiam hoc symbolum ab hominibus ad publica cum Deo foedera confirmanda vsurpabat, ex Dei voluntate vsurpari possit. Ier. 34. 18. 19.
Foedus totum gratuitum clarius proponitur, & sacramento circumcifionis confirmatur. Gene. 17. 7. 8. 9. 10. 11.

Circumcifionis sacramentum est primum siue initiationis sacramentum ordinarium, ad Christi ascen-sionem; quod per circumcifionem carnis præputij in mare, obsignabat in Christo foedus gratuitū, & nostram in ipsam insitionem. Gen. 17. 9. 10.
Eius mé-bra duo {Actio conferentis} Ibid. cum Rom. 2. 19. & 4. 11. {Actio recipientis.}
Actio conferentis {Externa. Interna.} Rom. 4. 11. cum Deut. 30. 6. 7. 8. Col. 2. 11. Rom. 5. 8.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left edge of the page (fragments of the facing page) are not legible enough to transcribe. The brace diagram is rendered in running text as far as possible; the braces could not be reproduced exactly. Several words in the body are uncertain due to the scan's faintness.
